The '''HH-50 heavy blaster pistol''' was a large-framed [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] made by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. Nearly the size of a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]], the HH-50 was the largest, heaviest, and most high-output [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] produced by BlasTech as of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], boasting a double-barreled design that shared various parts and systems with the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]-era [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15 blaster carbine]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />

Using patented dual-circuit [[galven pattern]] technology, an overcharged [[XCiter/Legends|XCiter]], and a powerful mix of [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gases]], the HH-50 packed a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]'s worth of stopping power, able to pierce thick hides. The pistol fired both barrels with one pull of its trigger, reaching out to a short range. Easy to use and relatively small, the weapon was also incredibly inefficient, even for a heavy blaster pistol, and its [[gas chamber]] tended to run dry at the worst opportunities. It had a [[Stun/Legends|stun setting]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />

Popular with [[Beast Riders (pilot)|beast riders]], cavalry [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], and vehicle crews, the pistol sold for 1,300 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
The HH-50 heavy blaster pistol was mentioned in the [[2014]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />
